units: <cite ref="Berakhot 7a:22">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>טובה מ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> one chastisement in the heart of man (self-reproach) is better than many lashes.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:2">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>, beg. <he>כולן לשון מ׳ הן</he> all (those names) have the meaning of chastisement; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:2">ib.</cite> s. 57 end.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:5">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> (play on <he>רד</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:7">Ex. XXXII, 7</cite>) <he>מ׳ הם צריכים</he> they need chastisement.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>כל המונע בנו מן המ׳</he> he who refrains from punishing his son; a. e.—[Pl. <he>מַרְדִּיּוֹת</he>. Tanḥ. M’tsora, ed. Bub. 3 <he>אין המרדות הללו משלי וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) these punishments do not come to thee by mistake (or suddenly, v. <cite ref="U01294"><he>שֶׁלִי</he></cite>, v. Bub. a. l. note 10), I have warned thee &c.; Tanḥ. ed. 1 <he>אין המרירות הזו וכ׳</he> (read: <he>המַרְדּוּת</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 558:1">Yalk. Lev. 558</cite> <he>אין המִדּוֹת הללו וכ׳</he>.]
